svg.title: How the worker runs forward and sampling in one step
svg.desc: execute_model updates request state, prepares input_ids, positions and attention metadata, and runs the forward pass by CUDA graph replay or a direct model call. It saves the hidden states and returns. sample_tokens then picks the hidden states at logits_indices, computes logits, and samples one token per request. While the GPU runs the forward pass, EngineCore computes the grammar bitmask on the CPU and passes it to sampling.
